blind.description: A stylized cubical metal cage constructed from thick dark iron beams with rivets and vertical bars. The front features an operable-style barred door mounted on two left-side hinges and secured with a small metal padlock on the right latch. The interior floor consists of warm brown wooden planks. The top surface has five parallel crossbars and a sturdy central eyelet ring for hanging. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with hand-painted metallic weathering. The cage sits flat on four integrated corner post feet directly on the floor.
blind.from_above: A square metal grate formed by thick outer framing and parallel horizontal bars, centered around a small metal lifting loop, through which the brown wooden planked floor below is clearly visible.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and about 2.5 feet wide.
